description.text: One of the two XY5 expansions released together on 13 December 2014: the land pack, with Primal Groudon on the wrapper, after its appearance in the Nintendo 3DS games Pokémon Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire that November. Primal Groudon-EX carries an Ancient Trait, a new kind of special power, and the two packs introduced four of them, Ω Barrier, α Growth, Ω Barrage and α Recovery; cards with an Ancient Trait have larger artwork. Groudon-EX, Aggron-EX and M Aggron-EX, Trevenant-EX and Camerupt-EX join it, with the Treecko and Torchic lines. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 70, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon-EX and Supporters and Ultra Rare gold Switch and Weakness Policy. In English it became part of Primal Clash in February 2015, together with Tidal Storm.
